diagram_previews.alt: A horizontal blue river line. The ninja N is to the upper left and the dojo D higher to the upper right. The path goes from N down to a point X on the river and up to D. A dashed segment continues from X to D', the reflection of D below the river, and a dotted segment joins D to D'.
